trip.title: Switzerland
assumptions: Every traveller holds a Swiss Half Fare Card (CHF 150 each, valid one calendar month).
Van collected Saturday 5 Sep morning at ZRH, returned Saturday 12 Sep early. Rental desks close 23:30, so no Friday-night pickup.
Accommodation figures are indicative ranges from published rates, not live quotes.
At five people a 7-seat MPV works: the back row folds flat for luggage. At six it would not have.
Fares are the operators' published 2026 tariffs, read in August 2026 from Jungfraubahnen, Männlichen, Schilthornbahn, Rigi Bahnen and SGV.

trip_wide_costs.note: The CHF 509 quote plus a second driver
Vignette already fitted on Swiss rentals. At CHF 1.97 a litre this leaves room to spare.

trip_wide_costs.item: Food beyond the two big shops
trip_wide_costs.note: Self-catered breakfasts and lunches, four dinners out for five at Swiss restaurant prices. Parking at Weggis, Lungern and Stechelberg is costed on the day; Grindelwald comes with the apartment.

days.title: Land at Zurich, sleep at the airport
days.movement: Terminal to hotel on the covered indoor walkway, about 10 minutes. No van tonight.
tips: Radisson Blu is the only genuinely terminal-connected hotel; reception is 24h and check-in runs to 23:59.
Avoid any shuttle hotel tonight - most shuttles stop at 23:30.

days.title: Collect the van, drive to Weggis, boat into Lucerne
days.movement: Rental Centre, Level 1 Airport Center (opens 06:00) then A4 south past Zug, exit Küssnacht am Rigi, 10 km along the lake to Weggis.
days.parents: Boat into Lucerne, flat pedestrian Old Town, Chapel Bridge, Lion Monument, boat back.
days.adults: Same, plus the Musegg Wall towers, which involve stairs.
tips: The big shop must happen before 17:00 - Sunday is closed.
See the Chapel Bridge early evening, not midday.
Restaurants near the KKL are jammed at 18:30 and 22:00 with concert crowds.
The last boat back from Lucerne leaves at 19:12 and reaches Weggis at 19:53. After that it is bus 502 by way of the train, about 50 minutes.

days.title: Mount Rigi
days.movement: Walk to the Weggis cable-car station in the village. Van stays parked.
days.parents: Cable car to Kaltbad, cogwheel to Rigi Kulm. Paved summit paths with a marked easier route. Kanzeli viewpoint from Kaltbad is about an hour, gentle.
days.adults: Rigi Panorama Trail, Kulm to Kaltbad: 6 km, 1h45, wide gravel, mostly downhill.
tips: Buy the Day Pass - same price as a single return but covers every train and cable car on the mountain.
Bring a picnic. Summit food is the most common complaint about Rigi.
Rain plan: boat to Flüelen and back by train, about CHF 27 half fare, three hours, no walking.
First cable car up from Weggis on a Sunday is 08:10, then every half hour until 19:10. The cogwheel from Kaltbad to Kulm runs hourly, so plan around it.

days.title: Over the Brünig to Grindelwald, by way of Lungern
days.movement: Weggis, A2 to Hergiswil, A8 over the Brünig Pass through Sarnen and Giswil. At Lungern leave the main road for the old Brünigstrasse along the lake, rejoin at Lungern Süd, then Meiringen, the north shore of Lake Brienz, Interlaken, Wilderswil, Zweilütschinen, Grindelwald.
days.parents: An hour at Lungern: the lakeside path at Obsee is flat and paved, with a restaurant at each end. Then the Pfingstegg terrace and restaurant, five minutes up by cable car.
days.adults: Lungern and the lake, then Pfingstegg plus the Fly-Line or the summer toboggan at CHF 8 a run, or on toward Berghaus Bäregg.
tips: Take the north-shore road along Lake Brienz rather than the tunnels.
Coop Grindelwald on Dorfstrasse is open 08:00-19:00 every day including Sundays.
There is no free parking in Grindelwald - insist on an included space when booking.
Lungern has a 3.5 km bypass tunnel. Follow the main road and you pass under the mountain and see nothing - take the old lakeside road, in at Lungern Nord and out at Lungern Süd.

days.title: Männlichen and the Panorama Trail
days.movement: Walk or local bus 121 (free on the guest card) to Grindelwald Terminal, Männlichen gondola 19-25 min. Return by cog train from Kleine Scheidegg. No driving.
days.parents: Panorama Trail Männlichen to Kleine Scheidegg: 4.9 km, 200 m downhill, about 90 minutes, officially rated easy and suitable for all ages and ability levels.
days.adults: Royal Walk to the true summit first (1 km, 15 min, steep), then the Panorama Trail, then on past Kleine Scheidegg to Wengernalp and Wengen.

per_person.item: Männlichen Panorama round trip: gondola up, cog train down

tips: The best day of the trip for the group as a whole.
Fallback if they would rather not walk: gondola back down and spend the afternoon on the flat paved Lauterbrunnen valley floor, bus 141 back every half hour.
Ask for the Panoramaweg round trip to Grindelwald Grund. Bought as a return the gondola costs CHF 17 more each, for a ride down you never take.

days.title: Jungfraujoch - Top of Europe
days.movement: Grindelwald Terminal, Eiger Express gondola to Eigergletscher (15 min), cog railway through the Eiger to Jungfraujoch (26-30 min). About 50 min each way. First departure around 08:00.
days.parents: Sphinx observatory by lift, Ice Palace, the Plateau. Ninety minutes to two hours is plenty at this height, then straight back down.
days.adults: Get off at Eigergletscher on the descent and walk the Eiger Trail to Alpiglen: 6.5 km, about 2.5 hours, mostly descending along the base of the Eiger north face. Train back from Alpiglen.

per_person.item: Jungfraujoch return from Grindelwald, half fare

group.item: Eiger Trail return leg, three adults

tips: THIS DAY FLOATS. Check the summit webcams at breakfast and go on the clearest morning.
September averages a high of 1 C and a low of minus 5 C at the top, before the wind. Coats, hats, gloves, sunglasses, sunscreen.
The final half-hour of the ascent is inside a tunnel with no view.
Do NOT buy the Good Morning Ticket - it cannot be combined with a Half Fare Card.

3,454 m. About half of adults get a headache, dizziness or no appetite up here, and it usually starts two to twelve hours in - which is exactly why a short visit is the plan. Move slowly, drink water, skip the alcohol, take the lift.
Anyone with a heart or lung condition, sleep apnoea, or on medication for either should ask their doctor before the trip, not on the platform. There is a staffed medical room with oxygen at the top.

days.title: Schilthorn, Piz Gloria and Mürren
days.movement: Drive Grindelwald to Stechelberg, 22 km, about 30 min. Park at the Schilthornbahn, CHF 11 for the day, open-air, no height limit. Descend a different way: Mürren, Grütschalp, Lauterbrunnen, then bus 141 back to the van.
days.parents: Summit, brunch at the revolving Piz Gloria, Bond World and Skyline Walk (both free). Then Mürren and the easy Mürren to Winteregg path, 1.5 km on level gravel with a restaurant and a station at the end.
days.adults: Stop at Birg for the Thrill Walk - 200 m of grating, glass floor and rope crossing bolted to the cliff, free. Then the full Grütschalp-Mürren panorama trail or the Northface Trail from Allmendhubel.

per_person.item: Schilthorn round trip via Grütschalp, half fare
Bus 141 Lauterbrunnen to Stechelberg, half fare

tips: Take one of the first cable cars: at the summit for 07:55, 08:25 or 08:45.
Book Piz Gloria for five. It revolves once every 45 minutes, brunch is served to 14:00, and a table reservation is required rather than advisable.
Ask for the round trip via Grütschalp, not a Stechelberg return. Both are CHF 115, but only the round trip covers coming down through Mürren and Lauterbrunnen.
Last cable car off the summit is 17:50. Mürren to Lauterbrunnen runs until 19:58 and bus 141 back to the van at Stechelberg until 23:29, so there is no rush.

days.title: The Aare Gorge, then back to Zurich
days.sleep: Kloten, near the airport (Welcome Inn, free parking)
days.movement: Grindelwald to Meiringen (30 min) for the gorge, back over the Brünig, past Lucerne, A4 to Kloten. About 2h45 driving plus stops. Leave around 09:30.
days.parents: Aare Gorge from the west entrance - smaller wheelchairs and narrow pushchairs manage to mid-gorge.
days.adults: Full 1.4 km of the gorge walkway, about an hour.
tips: Refuel this evening, not at 04:30. Rental is full-to-full.
Fill up in a town, never at a motorway services.
The Jungfrau Region guest card takes 20% off a single entry to the gorge. Ask at the desk whether it still counts on your checkout day.
Grindelwald fills for the Eidgenössisches Jugendjodelfest, 11 to 13 September. Leave the village by 09:30.

days.title: Early flight home
days.movement: Drive to Parking 3 for the rental return (accepts returns 24/7), then about 10 minutes on foot back to the terminal. Allow 30 minutes total.
tips: Work backwards from check-in and add 30 minutes for the return and walk.

weather_swaps.do: Swap the day entirely. The only thing here ruined by weather, and the most expensive ticket.
Boat to Flüelen and back by train. Three hours through the dramatic far end of the lake, seated, no walking.
Grindelwald First. Cliff Walk free with the gondola. Adventure Package CHF 81 reduced adds carts and trottibikes. Skip the First Flyer and Glider - 2-3 hour queues reported.
Harder Kulm. Ten-minute funicular from Interlaken, flat at the top, classic two-lakes view. Most accessible summit in the region.
Schynige Platte. Vintage cog railway, free alpine garden with 750+ species, notably quieter than the famous peaks.
Trümmelbach Falls. Ten glacier falls inside the mountain, but stairs beyond the halfway lift and permanently wet - adults only.

weather_swaps.instead_of: A clear morning on the Brünig
weather_swaps.do: Lungern-Turren. Ten minutes by cable car from Lungern-Obsee to a terrace facing the Bernese Alps across the lake. Runs 14 May to 1 November, 08:20 to 17:00 on a weekday.

weather_swaps.instead_of: A washed-out day in the valley
weather_swaps.do: Blausee. Fifty minutes each way from Grindelwald down the Kandertal, a forest lake that still works in drizzle, with a 300 m paved loop and a glass-bottomed rowing boat in the price.

booking_order: Grindelwald apartment, 7-10 September. Tightest item - Grindelwald hosts the first Eidgenössisches Jugendjodelfest on 11-13 September and the village is booked out around it. Three bedrooms sleeping five, with an included parking space.
Weggis, 5-6 September. The Vienna Philharmonic plays Lucerne both nights. Ask whether parking is included; it is CHF 13 a day if not.
Both airport hotels - Radisson Blu or Hyatt Place for the 4th, Welcome Inn Kloten or B&B Rümlang for the 11th.
Confirm the van at CHF 509 and add a second driver. Check height against 2.30 m.
Five Half Fare Cards, covering 4-12 September.
Jungfraujoch seat reservations, once the forecast is clear.
Piz Gloria brunch for five, Thursday. The table reservation is required.
Nothing else. Rigi, Lungern, Männlichen, Schilthorn, Pfingstegg and the Aare Gorge are all walk-up.

totals.note_vs_six: At six people the total would be about CHF 8,450 (CHF 1,408 each). Five costs less overall but more each, because the Grindelwald apartment, the van and the three hotel rooms at each end cost the same either way - and at six the luggage would not have fitted.
